article.body: New research explores the potential for "LLM agents" to cause financial instability in societies.  "Financial Fragility in Societies of LLM Agents: Coordination Failures and Stabilizing Mechanisms" examines how these agents might disrupt economic systems.  The authors highlight the potential for "coordination failures" and propose mechanisms for stabilizing these systems.  The research is based on the assumption that LLM agents will become increasingly prevalent in society.
